statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent shortness of breath
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Diagnosis codes I48.91 and I48.0 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is indicated to characterize the frequency and duration of arrhythmic events and guide long-term management
The service is medically necessary for the patient's condition
